name: Carob
description: Dried pod ground into a sweet powder — chocolate's caffeine-free stand-in.

unani.note: Kharrub is documented in Unani as cold and astringent, used for loose stools — the reverse of chocolate's reading.

histamine.note: Low, and specifically the substitute recommended in place of cocoa.

ref.as: carob, carob powder, carob pod meal
